cohort: 132,054 singleton term deliveries without congenital malformations, urgent CD, preeclampsia, gestational diabetes, placenta previa, labor induction, fetal growth restriction, preterm PROM, and instrumental deliveries
finding: Singleton term infants delivered by cesarean section have an increased risk of long-term cardiovascular morbidity, independent of maternal and pregnancy-related factors.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery at term is an independent risk factor for long-term cardiovascular morbidity in offspring.
